good_fit: Dusty surfaces, snowfields, frosted glass/leaves, chalk, peach skin epidermis, and planetary rings in PBRT, RenderMan, and Unreal
Integrating exp(-sigma_t * z * (1/mu_i + 1/mu_v)) analytically over z in [0, infinity) into 2*mu_i / (mu_i + mu_v)
Capturing the 1.6000x (mu_v=0.25) and 2.0000x (mu_v=0.00) grazing silhouette glow of shallow single scattering
Replacing 64-layer volumetric slab raymarching with 1 scalar division per pixel
not_for: Mirror-polished metallic conductors with zero subsurface penetration
Deep millimeter-scale multiple scattering in wax or jade (use Christensen-Burley Dipole Profile Round 108)
